decision_rationale: All 2 implemented unit tests for Lua integration (bytecode magic detection and capability set operations) pass successfully. zig build bench exits 0 with all expression evaluation benchmarks passing. However, test specification LUA-01-05.md defines 50+ comprehensive test cases across 5 requirement areas (binary verification, state isolation, stdlib restrictions, bytecode rejection, host API and capability enforcement), and current implementation covers only foundational bytecode detection and capability set initialization. Full requirement coverage requires completion of remaining 48+ test cases.

nfr_verification.notes: Stage 8 (Lua script execution) does not have direct NFR-01, NFR-02, or NFR-04 performance benchmarks. DSL-13 expression evaluation benchmarks (from previous stage) all pass with strong headroom (90% margin to 10µs threshold). Lua execution performance not formally benchmarked in this stage gate.

coverage_gaps: State isolation tests (sequential and concurrent global variable leakage)
Stdlib module availability tests (math, string, table positive cases)
Stdlib module blocking tests (io, os, package, debug negative cases)
Stdlib function removal tests (string.dump, load, loadstring, loadfile, dofile)
Host API registration tests (platform.call_service, read_variable, write_variable, log, emit_event, get_instance_state)
Capability enforcement tests (all 6 host functions with missing capabilities)
Binary dependency verification (no runtime Lua .so libraries)
Edge case tests (empty script, long script, syntax error, nested tables, Unicode, concurrency)

minor_issues.description: Test specification LUA-01-05.md defines 50+ comprehensive test cases covering bytecode rejection, stdlib restrictions, state isolation, host API registration, and capability enforcement. Current test implementation in lua_test.zig covers only 2 cases: capability_set_init_and_deinit and string_contains_bytecode_magic. All currently implemented tests pass, but substantial test gap remains. Full requirement coverage pending completion of 48+ additional test cases.
minor_issues.resolution_note: This is a test coverage gap, not a functional failure. The MVP implementation correctly initializes capability sets and detects bytecode magic numbers. Comprehensive testing of state isolation, stdlib whitelist enforcement, host API functionality, and capability checks is deferred to a subsequent stage/rework cycle.
